node.statement: Put h_1=(Ha^Q_{P,P})_1 and a_1=inf_{Z nonzero}||h_1(Z)||/||Z||. For each nonzero Z in S_P, validated nodes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 specialized to n=1 give ||h_1(Z)||^2>=||h_1(Z^dagger dot Z)||-C_prod e||Z||^2. By the definition of a_1 and the level-one square estimate in the preceding child, this is at least ((1-K_sq e)a_1-C_prod e)||Z||^2. Divide by ||Z||^2 and take the infimum: because every norm ratio is nonnegative, inf_Z (||h_1(Z)||/||Z||)^2=a_1^2. Thus a_1^2>=(1-K_sq e)a_1-C_prod e, equivalently p(a_1)>=0.
